key: BENNETT: Sorry about this, \PN.
en: BENNETT: Sorry about this, \PN.
ja: ベネット: すまないね、\PN。

key: That is, Elias actually asked me to let you in here.
en: That is, Elias actually asked me to let you in here.
ja: というより、イライアスが　きみをここへ通すよう　僕に頼んだんだ。

key: But you actually thought I was doing something dumb, didn't you?
en: But you actually thought I was doing something dumb, didn't you?
ja: でもきみは　僕が愚かなことをしていると思っていたんだろう?

key: It figures.
en: It figures.
ja: そうだろうね。

key: Most people don't seem to think very highly of me.
en: Most people don't seem to think very highly of me.
ja: たいていの人は　僕を高く評価しないものだ。

key: Which, I suppose, is typical of a person who prefers the company of bugs to that of people.
en: Which, I suppose, is typical of a person who prefers the company of bugs to that of people.
ja: まあ、人より虫と過ごすほうを好む人間には　よくあることだろう。

key: Ah, please do not mistake my standoffishness, shall we say, for any personal disdain.
en: Ah, please do not mistake my standoffishness, shall we say, for any personal disdain.
ja: ああ、この よそよそしさで　きみを見下していると　誤解しないでほしい。

key: I am merely doing what is best for my future, and for Luna.
en: I am merely doing what is best for my future, and for Luna.
ja: 僕はただ　自分の未来と　ルナのために最善を尽くしているだけだ。

key: ELIAS: And you have done well, Bennett.
en: ELIAS: And you have done well, Bennett.
ja: イライアス: よくやった、ベネット。

key: Continue your diligence, and I will surely secure a position in the Elite Four for you.
en: Continue your diligence, and I will surely secure a position in the Elite Four for you.
ja: その勤勉さを続けるがよい。必ずや四天王の座を用意しよう。

key: BENNETT: Of course.
en: BENNETT: Of course.
ja: ベネット: もちろんです。

key: Thank you, sir.
en: Thank you, sir.
ja: ありがとうございます。

key: ELIAS: Although I originally intended only to ask his help in finding Luna, Bennett has proven a surprisingly useful assistant.
en: ELIAS: Although I originally intended only to ask his help in finding Luna, Bennett has proven a surprisingly useful assistant.
ja: イライアス: もとはルナ探しの助けを求めただけだったが、ベネットは思いのほか有用な助手となった。

key: BENNETT: Naturally.
en: BENNETT: Naturally.
ja: ベネット: 当然です。

key: I also would do anything for Luna.
en: I also would do anything for Luna.
ja: 僕もルナのためなら何でもします。

key: This ceremony you spoke of will be beneficial to her, you said?
en: This ceremony you spoke of will be beneficial to her, you said?
ja: おっしゃっていた儀式は　彼女のためになる、と?

key: ELIAS: Indeed, it is a necessary step for her emotional and spiritual wellbeing.
en: ELIAS: Indeed, it is a necessary step for her emotional and spiritual wellbeing.
ja: イライアス: いかにも。あれの心と魂の安寧に　欠かせぬ段階だ。

key: We will begin shortly.
en: We will begin shortly.
ja: まもなく始める。

key: Until then, please see that \PN is confined safely in the dungeon.
en: Until then, please see that \PN is confined safely in the dungeon.
ja: それまで、\PNは地下室に　確実に閉じこめておけ。

key: We shall deal with that annoyance later.
en: We shall deal with that annoyance later.
ja: その厄介者は　あとで始末する。

key: BENNETT: Then, \PN, if you would follow me?
en: BENNETT: Then, \PN, if you would follow me?
ja: ベネット: では \PN、ついてきてもらえるかな?

key: Not that you have much of a choice with our numbers.
en: Not that you have much of a choice with our numbers.
ja: この人数では　選択の余地もないだろうけど。

key: Light shall consumeth all within its cleansing fires.
en: Light shall consumeth all within its cleansing fires.
ja: 光は　その清めの炎で　すべてを飲みこむであろう。

key: xx-xx
en: xx-xx
ja: xx-xx

key: All shall be white before the eyes of the Lord.
en: All shall be white before the eyes of the Lord.
ja: 主の御前では　すべてが白くなる。

key: The New World, too, shalt be Reborn.
en: The New World, too, shalt be Reborn.
ja: 新世界もまた　生まれ変わるのだ。

key: From the memories of eons passed and visions of eons yet to come...
en: From the memories of eons passed and visions of eons yet to come...
ja: 過ぎ去った遠い時の記憶と　来たるべき遠い時の幻より……

key: Suffer not the heretic to escape.
en: Suffer not the heretic to escape.
ja: 異端者を逃がしてはならぬ。

key: Suffer in defeat.
en: Suffer in defeat.
ja: 敗北に苦しむがよい。

key: Those without Arceus' light shall surely perish.
en: Those without Arceus' light shall surely perish.
ja: アルセウスの光なき者は　必ず滅びる。

key: Sure is nice to be sanctioned in Arceus' light.
en: Sure is nice to be sanctioned in Arceus' light.
ja: アルセウスの光に認められるって　いいものだな。

key: It hurts...
en: It hurts...
ja: 痛い……

key: I'm so cool.
en: I'm so cool.
ja: オレってかっこいい。

key: Won't you ascend with us?
en: Won't you ascend with us?
ja: 共に昇らないか?

key: Shame.
en: Shame.
ja: 残念だわ

key: Misery will be all of our undoing.
en: Misery will be all of our undoing.
ja: 苦しみこそが　我ら皆の破滅となる。

key: Punish the fools who desecrate the Lord's chamber!
en: Punish the fools who desecrate the Lord's chamber!
ja: 主の間を汚す愚か者どもを罰せよ!

key: You, too, will be judged.
en: You, too, will be judged.
ja: そなたもまた　裁かれるのだ

key: Repent now if you care for yourself.
en: Repent now if you care for yourself.
ja: 身が　惜しくば　今すぐ　悔い改めよ

key: Repent, sinner.
en: Repent, sinner.
ja: 悔い改めよ　罪人よ

key: You reject Arceus. So he shall reject you.
en: You reject Arceus. So he shall reject you.
ja: そなたは　アルセウスを　拒む。ならば　アルセウスも　そなたを　拒むだろう

key: This world is old, and forsaken. Thou art a fool to cling to it.
en: This world is old, and forsaken. Thou art a fool to cling to it.
ja: この世界は　古く　見捨てられた。しがみつくとは　愚かなり

key: I give my life!
en: I give my life!
ja: この命　ささげます!

key: End me... \n...No?
en: End me... \n...No?
ja: 我が命を　絶ってくれ……\n……やらぬのか?

key: For what then, shall I live, but the Lord Arceus?
en: For what then, shall I live, but the Lord Arceus?
ja: ならば　主アルセウスの　ほかに　何のために　生きよと?

key: The Lord shall be witness to your downfall.
en: The Lord shall be witness to your downfall.
ja: 主は　そなたの　没落を　見届けるだろう

key: The Lord favours you.
en: The Lord favours you.
ja: 主は　そなたに　味方している

key: How could he betray us?
en: How could he betray us?
ja: なぜ　あの方が　我らを　裏切るのだ?

key: Arceus, grant me strength!
en: Arceus, grant me strength!
ja: アルセウスよ　我に　力を!

key: Dear Lord...
en: Dear Lord...
ja: ああ　主よ……

key: Alas, our High Priest shall not bow so easily.
en: Alas, our High Priest shall not bow so easily.
ja: だが　我らの大司祭は　そう易々とは　屈しない

key: ACE: Did you miss me~?
en: ACE: Did you miss me~?
ja: エース: 俺がいなくて　寂しかったかい~?

key: I'm afraid the nature of show business is such that my work takes me behind the scenes from time to time,
en: I'm afraid the nature of show business is such that my work takes me behind the scenes from time to time,
ja: ショービジネスというのは　時として　舞台裏の仕事も　あるものでね、

key: But still, I was ever-so impressed with your display against Radomus!
en: But still, I was ever-so impressed with your display against Radomus!
ja: それでも　ラドマス相手の　あの一幕には　感服したよ!

key: He's a history with us, you see--
en: He's a history with us, you see--
ja: あいつとは　いろいろと　因縁があってな——

key: An illusionist, much like me--
en: An illusionist, much like me--
ja: 俺と同じ　幻術使い——

key: And you taking him out of the picture for just a moment was all the cue we needed!
en: And you taking him out of the picture for just a moment was all the cue we needed!
ja: 君が　ほんの一瞬　あいつを　舞台から　どけてくれた。それが　俺たちの　合図だったのさ!

key: While 'tis true that a favor done freely deserves one in kind, I'm afraid that this act is one that must go on!
en: While 'tis true that a favor done freely deserves one in kind, I'm afraid that this act is one that must go on!
ja: 受けた恩は　恩で返すのが　筋だが……この幕は　続けねばならないのでね!

key: Boss's orders and all.
en: Boss's orders and all.
ja: ボスの命令だ　悪く思うな

key: The family has business above, and it rather requires you to not interfere.
en: The family has business above, and it rather requires you to not interfere.
ja: ファミリーは　上で　仕事中でね。邪魔されては　困るのさ

key: Instead of intervention, I must insist on instigating an immediate intermission this instant!
en: Instead of intervention, I must insist on instigating an immediate intermission this instant!
ja: 介入は　ご遠慮願おう。ここで　即刻　幕間と　いこうじゃないか!

key: Let the curtain fall alongside you!
en: Let the curtain fall alongside you!
ja: 君もろとも　幕を　下ろしてやる!

key: But then, what am I if not a fool?
en: But then, what am I if not a fool?
ja: とはいえ　俺が　愚か者でなくて　何だろうな?

key: ACE: Well, it's another embarrassing mishap then.
en: ACE: Well, it's another embarrassing mishap then.
ja: エース: やれやれ　また　みっともない　しくじりか

key: Delightful.
en: Delightful.
ja: 実に　愉快だ

key: Perhaps I truly have outstayed my usefulness.
en: Perhaps I truly have outstayed my usefulness.
ja: 俺の使い道は　とっくに　尽きていたのかもな

key: They've no need for my real talents with "T" about, and paltry tricks can only keep one relevant for so long.
en: They've no need for my real talents with "T" about, and paltry tricks can only keep one relevant for so long.
ja: 「T」がいる以上　俺の本当の腕は　用なしだ。安手の手品では　いつまでも　もちはしない

key: Tell me, \PN, what is family to you?
en: Tell me, \PN, what is family to you?
ja: なあ　\PN　君にとって　家族とは　何だ?

key: Is it those with whom you share blood and status, or those with whom you share loyalty?
en: Is it those with whom you share blood and status, or those with whom you share loyalty?
ja: 血と地位を　分かち合う者か。それとも　忠誠を　分かち合う者か?

key: ACE: As many would surely say.
en: ACE: As many would surely say.
ja: エース: 多くの者が　そう答えるだろうな

key: You know, I first came to this region because of my cousin.
en: You know, I first came to this region because of my cousin.
ja: 俺が　この地方に　来たのは　いとこのせいでね

key: She's one for the spotlight as well,
en: She's one for the spotlight as well,
ja: あいつも　スポットライトが　好きな女だ、

key: But her head is always too far in the clouds to see the rest of us down on the ground.
en: But her head is always too far in the clouds to see the rest of us down on the ground.
ja: だが　いつも　雲の上ばかり見ていて　地上の　俺たちなど　目に入らない

key: Despite our kinship, I hardly registered on her radar.
en: Despite our kinship, I hardly registered on her radar.
ja: 血縁だというのに　俺なんぞ　眼中に　なかったのさ

key: Pity, isn't it?
en: Pity, isn't it?
ja: 哀れなものだろう?

key: What is one to do when shooed offstage but to find a new venue?
en: What is one to do when shooed offstage but to find a new venue?
ja: 舞台から　追い払われたら　新しい劇場を　探すしか　あるまい?

key: And here was one that needed me.
en: And here was one that needed me.
ja: そして　ここには　俺を　必要とする場所が　あった

key: ACE: It is a lovely lie to tell.
en: ACE: It is a lovely lie to tell.
ja: エース: 実に　心地よい　うそだな

key: Yet, what is loyalty but an illusion?
en: Yet, what is loyalty but an illusion?
ja: だが　忠誠など　しょせんは　幻だ

key: It is a promise of intentions in a future which cannot be promised.
en: It is a promise of intentions in a future which cannot be promised.
ja: 約束できぬ未来に　心づもりを　約束するようなもの

key: Still, for some of us, we have nothing else.
en: Still, for some of us, we have nothing else.
ja: それでも　それしか　持たぬ者も　いる

key: We cling to fantastical illusions because the truth is too empty to face.
en: We cling to fantastical illusions because the truth is too empty to face.
ja: 真実が　あまりに　むなしいから　俺たちは　夢のような幻に　すがるのさ

key: And here was a group that needed such promises.
en: And here was a group that needed such promises.
ja: そして　ここには　そんな約束を　必要とする　集団が　あった

key: Their goals are neither ignoble nor righteous.
en: Their goals are neither ignoble nor righteous.
ja: あいつらの目的は　卑しくもなく　正しくもない

key: But they were family,
en: But they were family,
ja: だが　あいつらは　家族だった、

key: And I needed that.
en: And I needed that.
ja: 俺には　それが　必要だったのさ

key: LUNA: Please, stop this already!
en: LUNA: Please, stop this already!
ja: ルナ: もう　やめてください!

key: Get your hands off of me!
en: Get your hands off of me!
ja: 手を　放して!

key: ACE: Ah, it appears the moment for monologuing has passed.
en: ACE: Ah, it appears the moment for monologuing has passed.
ja: エース: おっと　独白の時間は　終わりのようだ

key: Let us see what business our happy family is at now.
en: Let us see what business our happy family is at now.
ja: 仲良し家族が　何をしているか　見にいこうじゃないか

key: ELIAS: I see neither steel nor charlatan can bar you from thrusting yourself into matters which need not concern you, \PN.
en: ELIAS: I see neither steel nor charlatan can bar you from thrusting yourself into matters which need not concern you, \PN.
ja: イライアス: 鋼も　いかさま師も　あなたを　止められぬようですね。関わりのないことに　首を突っ込む　\PN

key: So be it.
en: So be it.
ja: ……そう　定められていたのだ

key: If you are so determined, you may observe our ceremony.
en: If you are so determined, you may observe our ceremony.
ja: そこまで　言うのなら　儀式を　見ることは　許しましょう

key: But you will ONLY observe.
en: But you will ONLY observe.
ja: ただし　見るだけです

key: Bennett?
en: Bennett?
ja: ベネット?

key: ELIAS: Move so much as one muscle, and I'll have my assistant put an end to your friend here.
en: ELIAS: Move so much as one muscle, and I'll have my assistant put an end to your friend here.
ja: イライアス: 指一本でも　動かせば　助手に　この友人を　始末させます

key: CAIN: Ughh, if you're going to have me tied up, at least ask for my safe word.
en: CAIN: Ughh, if you're going to have me tied up, at least ask for my safe word.
ja: カイン: うぇー　縛るなら　セーフワードくらい　聞いてほしいなぁ

key: ELIAS: Even in these sacred halls, your perversion abounds.
en: ELIAS: Even in these sacred halls, your perversion abounds.
ja: イライアス: 聖なる場でさえ　その下劣さですか

key: CAIN: I've heard that one before.
en: CAIN: I've heard that one before.
ja: カイン: それ　前にも　言われたなぁ

key: BENNETT: Please stop saying things like that.
en: BENNETT: Please stop saying things like that.
ja: ベネット: そういうことを　言うのは　やめてくれ

key: CAIN: I'm not taking orders from you~
en: CAIN: I'm not taking orders from you~
ja: カイン: キミの命令なんて　聞かないよ~

key: You are sooooo not my type.
en: You are sooooo not my type.
ja: キミ　ぜんっぜん　ボクの　タイプじゃないし

key: What is your hair even doing?
en: What is your hair even doing?
ja: その髪　どうなってるわけ?

key: BENNETT: My time is better spent on studies than on perms, thank you.
en: BENNETT: My time is better spent on studies than on perms, thank you.
ja: ベネット: パーマより　研究に　時間を使うほうが　有意義でね

key: ACE: You could stand to find room for both.
en: ACE: You could stand to find room for both.
ja: エース: 両方に　時間を割いても　いいと思うがね

key: For some, presentation is everything!
en: For some, presentation is everything!
ja: 見せ方が　すべてという者も　いるんだ!

key: CAIN: I don't know how I feel about you of all people backing me up here...
en: CAIN: I don't know how I feel about you of all people backing me up here...
ja: カイン: よりによって　キミに　味方されるのは　微妙な気分だなぁ……

key: ACE: Ah, still smarting about the taller of my tales, are we?
en: ACE: Ah, still smarting about the taller of my tales, are we?
ja: エース: おや　俺の大ぼらが　まだ　こたえているのかい?

key: As I said just moments ago, loyalty is but an illusion!
en: As I said just moments ago, loyalty is but an illusion!
ja: さっきも　言ったろう。忠誠など　ただの幻さ!

key: Loyalty is nothing but an illusion, little friend!
en: Loyalty is nothing but an illusion, little friend!
ja: 忠誠なんてものは　ただの幻だよ　坊や!

key: We allow ourselves to be deceived when it is most convenient to us.
en: We allow ourselves to be deceived when it is most convenient to us.
ja: 人は　都合のいいときだけ　自ら　だまされてやるのさ

key: And was it not convenient indeed, for you then?
en: And was it not convenient indeed, for you then?
ja: あのときの君にも　都合が　よかったんじゃないか?

key: It nearly led you to your own family-- had you but the heart to take a few steps further forward.
en: It nearly led you to your own family-- had you but the heart to take a few steps further forward.
ja: あと数歩　踏み出す度胸が　あれば　君は　自分の家族に　たどり着いていた——

key: ELIAS: It seems it is all too easy for the young to turn their back on those to whom they are bound.
en: ELIAS: It seems it is all too easy for the young to turn their back on those to whom they are bound.
ja: イライアス: 若い者は　結ばれた相手に　背を向けることを　あまりに　たやすく　考える

key: Yet what right have you to do so, my child?
en: Yet what right have you to do so, my child?
ja: だが　我が子よ　あなたに　その権利が　ありますか?

key: You, especially, who are raised in service of stability--
en: You, especially, who are raised in service of stability--
ja: 秩序に　仕えるべく　育てられた　あなたなら　なおさら——

key: Selfishness can only be abided by for so long.
en: Selfishness can only be abided by for so long.
ja: わがままが　許されるのにも　限りがあります

key: There is a legacy far greater than you or I at stake here, and I cannot permit you to stray from it.
en: There is a legacy far greater than you or I at stake here, and I cannot permit you to stray from it.
ja: ここには　あなたや　私よりも　はるかに大きな　遺産が　かかっている。そこから　外れることは　許しません

key: As my master and I did once resent this, we eventually came to accept our place in the world.
en: As my master and I did once resent this, we eventually came to accept our place in the world.
ja: 私も　我が主も　かつては　これを　うとましく思った。だが　やがて　己の居場所を　受け入れたのです

key: So, too, must you.
en: So, too, must you.
ja: あなたも　そうすべきだ

key: It is a necessary movement for the sake of your moral health.
en: It is a necessary movement for the sake of your moral health.
ja: それは　あなたの　徳の健やかさのために　必要な　歩みです

key: For you, and for the sanctity of your faith, I shall do this.
en: For you, and for the sanctity of your faith, I shall do this.
ja: あなたのため　そして　信仰の神聖さのため　私は　これを　行います

key: LUNA: You may find that I yet have plenty of faith,
en: LUNA: You may find that I yet have plenty of faith,
ja: ルナ: わたしにも　信仰は　まだ　たくさんあります、

key: But rather than in scripture or legacy, I prefer to have faith in myself.
en: But rather than in scripture or legacy, I prefer to have faith in myself.
ja: でも　聖典や　遺産よりも　わたしは　自分自身を　信じたい

key: What I know, feel, and hold to be true is greater than the rules which tradition bade I follow.
en: What I know, feel, and hold to be true is greater than the rules which tradition bade I follow.
ja: わたしが　知り　感じ　真実と信じるものは　伝統が　命じた　決まりよりも　大きい

key: I would not be who I am otherwise.
en: I would not be who I am otherwise.
ja: そうでなければ　わたしは　わたしでなくなる

key: ELIAS: Who you are has led you too far astray.
en: ELIAS: Who you are has led you too far astray.
ja: イライアス: その　あなた自身が　あなたを　迷わせすぎたのです

key: It is exactly for that reason that we must do this.
en: It is exactly for that reason that we must do this.
ja: だからこそ　これを　行わねばならない

key: ELIAS: We will begin by correcting your sacrilegious appearance with a shave of the head.
en: ELIAS: We will begin by correcting your sacrilegious appearance with a shave of the head.
ja: イライアス: まずは　その不敬な姿を　正すため　髪を　そり落とします

key: It is unbecoming and antithetical to the traditional style of the servants of our family,
en: It is unbecoming and antithetical to the traditional style of the servants of our family,
ja: 我が家に仕える者の　伝統の姿に　ふさわしくなく　反するものだ、

key: And I believe you have placed too much fantasy in your notions of looking a certain way.
en: And I believe you have placed too much fantasy in your notions of looking a certain way.
ja: それに　あなたは　見た目という幻想に　こだわりすぎている

key: LUNA: Wait, please--
en: LUNA: Wait, please--
ja: ルナ: 待って　やめて——

key: ELIAS: Defaeco, Purgo... Silentium, Pupa.
en: ELIAS: Defaeco, Purgo... Silentium, Pupa.
ja: イライアス: Defaeco, Purgo…… Silentium, Pupa

key: BENNETT: Sir-- is this... really necessary?
en: BENNETT: Sir-- is this... really necessary?
ja: ベネット: あの——これは……本当に　必要なんですか?

key: ACE: You're not going to win any favor that way, that's for sure.

en: And here I thought you understood that we were doing this for her sake.

en: Her resistance only speaks to its necessity.

ja: あの子の体は　徳を　果たすための　器——

en: Its priority is not for your lecherous consumption.

en: If you truly cared about her, you would understand that this is a necessary step for her to correct her spirit.

key: It is their consent and participation that matters!
en: It is their consent and participation that matters!
ja: 大事なのは　客の　同意と　参加なのさ!

en: RADOMUS: And if you don't mind, we'll be taking this back.
ja: ラドマス: それと　悪いが　これは　返してもらう

ja: ラドマスは　イライアスから　アメジストのペンダントを　奪い取った!

en: GARDEVOIR: Bennett, darling, would you mind stepping away from the pretty boy?

en: BENNETT: Gardevoir, it's been a while...

en: This is quite a far cry from the way you behave at my mother's place.
ja: 母の家での　君の振る舞いとは　ずいぶん　違うじゃないか

key: CAIN: There, she's free!
en: CAIN: There, she's free!

en: But is this really the kind of family you want to have?

en: Because I don't think it is.
